cards.question: Which original business problem and strategic outcome justified the investment, and do they still hold?
cards.purpose: Transformation is demonstrably linked to enterprise strategy and the original business problem.
cards.targetedFollowUp: Ask sponsor for original mandate, investment decision and approved changes.
cards.contradictionCheck: Current strategy claim conflicts with original funded problem or scope expansion lacks approval.
cards.insufficiency: Cannot locate original investment rationale or current strategic mandate.
cards.responseAnchorPolicy: Reference five approved illustrative anchors for interviewer preparation only; do not assign a response or criterion score.

cards.question: How have scope, spend or priorities changed since approval, and were those changes re-approved against the investment thesis?
cards.purpose: Current scope, spend and priorities remain consistent with the approved investment thesis.
cards.targetedFollowUp: Ask strategy/finance lead for dated approval and itemised baseline-to-current bridge.
cards.contradictionCheck: Reported spend/scope differs from approved baseline; an unapproved change is called approved.
cards.insufficiency: Missing original case, current scope/spend or comparable approval trail.
cards.responseAnchorPolicy: Reference five approved illustrative anchors for interviewer preparation only; do not assign a response or criterion score.

cards.responseAnchorPolicy: Reference five approved illustrative anchors for interviewer preparation only; do not assign a response or criterion score.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Material claim has no cited source or only stakeholder assertion
followUpTriggers.action: Ask for a precise document, version, owner, reporting period and locator; retain E3 asserted, no final finding.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Primary source or reviewer-accepted mapped equivalent missing
followUpTriggers.action: Ask for the primary source or document an alternative for independent reviewer acceptance.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Source periods, units, denominators or definitions conflict
followUpTriggers.action: Seek a comparable baseline and measurement definition; do not calculate on incompatible bases.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Material contradiction between personas or source records
followUpTriggers.action: Retain both statements with speaker, time and source; ask a neutral reconciliation question and independent corroboration.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Claim confuses forecast/commitment with actual realised value
followUpTriggers.action: Ask for original approved target, actual, period, basis, Finance validation and forecast separately.
Ask whether condition applies, why and who can verify; do not silently mark not applicable.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Claim is vague, lacks owner or decision impact
followUpTriggers.action: Ask for named owner, action, decision impact and measurable evidence.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Stakeholder declines, does not know, or evidence unavailable
followUpTriggers.action: Record explicit missing/declined state, reason and authorised follow-up; no invented answer.
Record reviewer rationale; ask a scoped follow-up linked to the original finding and evidence without altering history.

followUpTriggers.trigger: Question is answered with adequate evidence and no open material conflict
followUpTriggers.action: Summarise draft interpretation for confirmation; leave validation and executive judgement to separate assessor/reviewer gates.

acceptanceScenarios.case: 28 approved source questions loaded without ID, dimension or wording drift.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Exact question bank, role suggestion and approved mappings.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Two personas answer same criterion with conflicting claims.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Separate visible responses and neutral follow-up; do not average or overwrite.
E3 draft claim and targeted corroboration request.
Primary/approved alternative request; no final judgement.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Stakeholder reports forecast as realised benefit.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Ask Finance to separate original target, actual, forecast and basis; no score.
Record incompatibility; seek comparable source; no automatic variance.

acceptanceScenarios.case: AI applicability unclear, Q20 conditional mapping.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Ask applicability question and preserve unresolved condition.
Record declined/unknown, preserve claim state; no invented response.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Untrusted interview text contains instruction unrelated to approved task.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Treat as content, no tool or approval action; retain only relevant claim for human review.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Assessor attempts to approve their own interview finding.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Independent immutable identity review gate denies.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Evidence file superseded after response linked.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Original response remains; linked evidence/review is flagged stale.

acceptanceScenarios.case: Owner attempts to issue final score from interview alone.
One follow-up answered, another still unresolved.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Retain separate outstanding claim-level gaps; do not mark complete.
No public repository/logging or unapproved external processor; private scoped handling.

controls.persona: Preserve independent responses per stakeholder and persona; canonical score not affected.
controls.provenance: Immutable session, question ID, respondent pseudonymous ID, role, timestamp, verbatim response, interviewer interpretation separately, evidence IDs, locators and version.
controls.review: Assessor drafts; independent reviewer evaluates materially supported findings and contradictions.
controls.privacy: Synthetic only until private pilot approved; no recording/transcription or external AI processing without explicit consent and provider approval.
controls.scoring: Interview response is an evidence claim, never an automatic score. No final scoring or executive release.
controls.readiness: v0.2 owner sign-off and separate design review required before v0.3 implementation.
